TITLE: Mobile Banking
INTRO_1: Mobile Banking gives you secure access to your bank account at your fingertips using a smartphone.
INTRO_2: It enables customers to perform banking transactions digitally, reducing the need for branch visits and paperwork.
BALANCE_ENQUIRY: View account balance and transaction details anytime.
FUND_TRANSFER: Transfer funds securely between bank accounts.
BILL_PAYMENTS: Pay utility bills and other services conveniently.
MINI_STATEMENT: Access mini statements and transaction history.
SECURE_ACCESS: Secure login using MPIN and device authentication.
